eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Kanawha, WV; at 5:39 AM on AUG 28, 2023 Effective until 9:39 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Residents in the area of Wet Branch Rd, Dry Branch Rd at Cabin Creek Rd are urged to seek higher ground or evacuate if safe to do so due to flooding in the area immediately. Do not drive through high water. See higher ground or evacuate if safe to do so.
